$$H_0(\partial B;\mathbb{Z}) \xrightarrow{\;\cong\;} H_0(X \setminus B;\mathbb{Z}) \longrightarrow H_0(X \setminus B, \partial B;\mathbb{Z}) \longrightarrow 0,$$

$$\|\hat{s}\| \geq \|s\| - \tfrac{m}{2} > \tfrac{m}{2} > 0 \quad\text{on } X \setminus B,$$
so $\hat{s}$ is a smooth vector field on $X$, **non-vanishing on $X \setminus B$**, with all zeros contained in $B$.

**Step 3 (Making zeros finite via transversality).**

Over the coordinate ball $B$, the bundle $TX|_B$ is trivial, so $\hat{s}|_B$ is a smooth map $B \to \mathbb{R}^n$.
